The '''Mid-Season Invitational''' (commonly referred to as ''MSI'') is the second cross-regional competition of the annual LoL Esports calendar. It features ten teams, two from each pro region. MSI 2025 was held in Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.instagram.com/lolesports/p/DB1ID1JoD1M/|title=Canada: see you soon!|date=2024-11-01|publisher=LoL Esports}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |publisher=Riot Games |title=Welcome to Noxus {{!}} Dev Update - League of Legends |url=https://youtu.be/z76xgEYgjt0?t=11m22s |date=2025-01-08}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=LoL Esports in 2025 |url=https://lolesports.com/en-US/news/lol-esports-in-2025 |date=2025-01-08 |publisher=LoL Esports}}</ref>

==Format==
* '''Qualification'''
** The top two teams from each region (10 total) participate in MSI. 
** The 1st seed of each region and 2nd seed of [[LCK/2025/Road to MSI|LCK]] (the winning region of [[First Stand Tournament/2025|FST 2025]]) will get a bye into the Bracket Stage, while the other 4 teams will start from Play-In.

* '''Play-In''' - ''June 27th - 29th''
** 4 teams play in a ''[[starcraft2:Dual Tournament Format|GSL-Style Group]]''
** Teams are seeded based on the results from [[First Stand Tournament/2025|FST 2025]]
** Top 2 teams (the 2-0 and 2-1 teams) advance the Bracket Stage.
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}} with {{Abbr/Fearless Draft}}.

* '''Bracket Stage''' - ''July 1st - 12th''
** 8 teams play double elimination bracket. 
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}} with {{Abbr/Fearless Draft}}.
** The winner of MSI qualifies for [[World Championship/2025|Worlds]] if they reach their regional playoffs in Split 3 and the 2nd place region gets a 4th seed for its domestic league at Worlds.

* '''Patch Information'''
** All matches are played in [[Patch 25.13]]

===MSI 2025 Draw Show===
* '''Bracket Stage'''
** <span class="mw-customtoggle-Swiss-Draw" style="border-bottom:1px dotted;">''Click here for detailed information about Bracket Stage Draw show''</span>
<div class="toccolours mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" id="mw-customcollapsible-Swiss-Draw" style="margin-top:10px;">
* Teams are splited into 4 seed pools to ensure quality groups. The seed pools are determined based on performance at [[First Stand/2025|FST 2025]].
** 8 teams are splited into 4 pools
*** '''Pool 1''' will consist of LCK1 (''GEN''), LEC1 (''MKOI'')
*** '''Pool 2''' will consist of LCP1 (''CFO''), and LPL1 (''AL'').
*** '''Pool 3''' will consist of LTA1 (''FLY''), and LCK2 (''T1'').
*** '''Pool 4''' will consist of the 2 teams who qualified from Play-ins (''BLG'' and ''G2'').
* Pool 1 teams will face Pool 4 teams, while Pool 2 teams will face Pool 3 teams in the first round.
* Each region can only have one team in each half of the upper bracket.
** As a result, dependent on the results of the Play-ins, there is no need for a draw show.
</div>
